items.title: Gucci launches Primavera campaign film starring Kate Moss
items.summary: Official Gucci account posted the Primavera campaign: a short film directed by Johan Renck starring Kate Moss lip-syncing Chris Isaak's 'Wicked Game', alongside a Michal Chelbin portrait series with Tom Brady, Shawn Mendes, Xiao Zhan, Jin, NINGNING, Alex Consani, Lee Young Ae, Rico Nasty and Tarzzan, built around Demna's debut collection.

items.title: Kate Moss sings 'Wicked Game' for Gucci Primavera
items.summary: Italian trade outlet nss magazine covers the Primavera campaign launch, describing the short film's theme of strangers finding connection through dance, and detailing the ambassador portrait series tied to Demna's runway debut pieces.

items.title: Gucci's new campaign is a sultry Kate Moss karaoke
items.summary: UK culture/fashion outlet frames the Primavera campaign as 'sharper, more confrontational, and intentionally divisive' compared with Gucci's recent eclectic storytelling, calling it a considered effort to keep the brand tied to its sexy heritage under Demna.

items.title: Gucci Primavera: le nuove muse di Demna
items.summary: Italian outlet covers the Primavera portrait cast (Tom Brady, NINGNING, Shawn Mendes, Xiao Zhan, Jin, Alex Consani), framing Demna's strategy of building a globally recognizable cast of ambassadors rather than a single spokesperson.

items.title: Kering stock trades in the mid-EUR250 range as Gucci slowdown weighs on luxury sentiment
items.summary: German financial wire reports Kering shares holding around EUR255, down roughly 13.6% year-to-date, with sector sentiment pressured by continuing softness tied to Gucci and broader China demand weakness reported in late-July/August data.

items.title: Kering plombé par Gucci et le ralentissement du marché du luxe
items.summary: French financial media continues to attribute Kering's group-level weakness principally to Gucci's ongoing underperformance amid the broader luxury slowdown, with China demand cited as an aggravating factor into late August.

items.title: 2026 Gucci Flora thread - active community discussion
items.summary: Enthusiast community thread discussing the reissued Gucci Flora print under Demna across Jackie, tote, bucket bag and GG Marmont styles; comments mix nostalgic approval with notes comparing quality/construction to earlier Flora-era pieces.

items.title: Forum members review Demna's Fall 2026 runway debut as Gucci creative director
items.summary: Fashion enthusiast forum roundup shows split reactions to Demna's debut: critics call it 'one big cliche' and a 'mash-up of Tom Ford's Gucci mixed with Balenciaga rehash', while others praise 'a complete vision' and call it 'a great fashion moment', reflecting continued polarized community sentiment weeks after the show.
